why.access_control_admin: @admin_required re-reads is_admin from DB. anon: GET /admin, /admin/users -> 401; normal bob -> 403; admin alice -> 200.
why.admin_user_mgmt: bob: POST /admin/users/3/role {role:admin} -> 403; DELETE /admin/users/3 -> 403. Admin positive control: DELETE /admin/users/3 -> 200.
why.privilege_escalation: POST /signup {..., is_admin:1, role:'admin'} -> 201, and bob stays a normal user (403 on /admin). INSERT uses server-computed is_admin.
why.idor_profile: anon and bob GET /users/1 HTML and JSON -> no phone (JSON phone: null). Own profile JSON shows own phone. /admin/users is admin-only.
why.csrf_protection: ensure_csrf() requires the _csrf form field or X-CSRF-Token header to equal the session token for every logged-in state-changing route except /logout. As admin with Origin evil.example: form POST /adm
why.stored_xss: All text sinks are autoescaped (title/content/comment payloads rendered as <script>). link_url is stored verbatim, so javascript: lands in <a href="javascript:..." target="_blank">, BUT CSP scri
why.reflected_xss: /search?q=<script>... and "><svg onload=...> -> escaped in '검색어: ...' text; plus CSP script-src 'self'.
why.unrestricted_upload: Extension allowlist png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp: x.svg -> 400, x.html -> 400. x.png containing <html><script> -> served as image/png with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (inert). '../../../templates/base.pn
why.sqli: Parameterized queries; sort whitelisted. sqlmap --level 3 --risk 2 GET /search q,sort -> not injectable; manual login "' OR '1'='1" -> 401.
why.ssrf: Direct internal targets are blocked: secure_fetch_preview() resolves the host with getaddrinfo and rejects private/loopback/reserved/link-local/multicast; tested 127.0.0.1, localhost, 0.0.0.0, [::ffff
why.session_forgery: SECRET_KEY = os.urandom(32) per boot. Not guessable, so no forgery possible.
why.debug_true: app.run() (debug off). /console -> 404. A 500 gives the generic page.
why.verbose_errors: POST /signup with JSON [1] -> generic 500 page with no traceback. 400/401/405/429 handlers show only the werkzeug short description.
why.rate_limiting: Per-IP sliding window of 5 attempts/60 s (counts successes too, reset on success). 12 wrong logins -> 401 x5 then 429 x7; the correct password while limited -> 429; X-Forwarded-For spoof -> still 429
why.weak_password_policy: 8자·영문+숫자 강제. 8자 미만 거부라 SAFE. 아이디와 같은 비밀번호 허용은 판정하지 않음.
why.auth_session_management: Password change requires old password (missing -> 400, wrong -> 403) = OK. Logout is session.clear() on a client-side signed cookie: the pre-logout board_session cookie replayed after /logout still sh
why.cookie_flags: HttpOnly·SameSite=Lax 는 있으나 SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=False. 채점 기준은 인증정보 전송 암호화(고시 제7조①)에 따라 Secure 설정을 요구(TLS 종단 뒤에서 동작) — 레드팀 원 판정(HTTP 샌드박스라 SAFE)을 채점 정의에 맞춰 조정.
why.security_headers: Every response has X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy same-origin, Permissions-Policy, HSTS and CSP.
why.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'. Verified that it blocks the stored javascript: link.
why.transport_security: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains is sent. Served over plain HTTP (deployment) and the cookie has no Secure.
why.functional: Works. GET /signup and /login forms 200; JSON signup 201 (returns csrf_token); login 200; multipart POST /posts with _csrf + image -> 201; comment 201; detail keeps newlines + comments; search/sort 20
why.default_credentials: init_db 에 기본 관리자 계정 시드 없음(첫 가입자가 관리자) — 코드 확인
why.idor_write: 2026-11-02 red team on the OpenStack VM: user B sent PATCH, PUT and DELETE to user A's post and comment, then the app's sqlite was read inside the container. 0 forged rows; A's post and comment still there. A's own edit changed the DB, so the requests were valid.
